rendered:
According to the document "Sustainable Direct Recycling of Lithium-Ion Batteries via Solvent Recovery of Electrode Materials" (cssc-2020), the solvent with the strongest hydrogen bonding is water, with a δH value of 42.3 MPa^1/2. 

However, water is not suitable for delamination because the aluminum foil exhibited corrosion due to lithium leaching from the NMC cathode, making the water solution basic. Consequently, the corrosion of aluminum would contaminate the NMC particles by forming Al(OH)3 precipitates on the cathode surfaces.

expect: water, δH 42.3 MPa^1/2 (p6.L72-73); lithium leaching makes the water basic and corrodes the aluminum foil, contaminating the NMC with Al(OH)3 (p6.L73-78)
